items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Sherrie Maricle. Terrific. I realize that really we have been neglecting a great resource.

ctx.x: Sherrie Maricle. Terrific. I realize that really we have been neglecting a great resource. And this is the first party, the first casting I’ve seen in which these terrific players are represented without being an all-girl band and which is kind of an insulting thing anyhow. So I’m happy to see that. Where the music is going I don’t know. Who can possibly say? I find that I’m less interested in such conjectures and just trying to concentrate on where I’m going.
